pages.text: The Lumenwrights did not climb — they floated. A $(l)Lumen Field Projector$(/l) projects a gravity column from one face: ride it up (Ascension) or safely down (Descent). Right-click to toggle the mode.

A column reaches 16 blocks. Mount a $(l)Gravity Repeater$(/l) flush in the shaft wall and it resets that range, chaining a shaft arbitrarily tall. You'll find these working in the abandoned mines beneath Vestige Cities — built from real, reusable parts.
